caseNameFull: L'Hommedieu v. Board of Regents of the University of the State of New York
attorneys: Edward J. Ennis for appellants., Nathaniel L. Goldstein, Attorney General of New York, for appellees.
judges: Adler, Black, Douglas, Education, Frankfurter, Opinions, Respective, Stated, Supra

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The judgment is affirmed. Adler v.' Board of Education, 342 U. S. 485, decided March 3, 1952.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Frankfurter, and Mr. Justice Douglas dissent for the reasons stated in their respective dissenting opinions in Adler v. Board of Education, supra, at pp. 496, 497, 508.
